notes: Rule 425 / 8-K filing by SLR Investment Corp. (acquirer, SLRC) announcing a merger agreement dated December 1, 2021 with SLR Senior Investment Corp. (SUNS). Two steps in one agreement: Merger Sub into SUNS, then SUNS into SLRC; treated as one event with one target. Exchange ratio is set at closing as the ratio of closing per-share NAVs (nav_for_nav basis); no fixed ratio is stated, so exchange_ratio is null. The SUNS ticker is not printed in the excerpt (SUNS is a defined term only), so subject_tickers carries SLRC alone. Fund type bdc is stated in the excerpt (both parties elected BDC status). Meeting and record dates are not stated, so null. Termination fees (about $25.6m and $7.6m) are stated but have no field in this kind's schema, so they are not extracted. The excerpt ends in Article IV of Exhibit 2.1 (SLRC Financial Statements representations), so later terms after the cut are null.
